name: Atlassian
description: Atlassian's remote MCP server covers Jira and Confluence in the sites you approve. The agent searches, reads and edits issues and pages. Sign-in goes through Atlassian's own OAuth consent, and the granted sites bound what it can reach.

probe.note: Returns 401 invalid_token without a bearer token, but does not advertise resource_metadata in the challenge and has no protected-resource document at /v1/mcp's well-known path; the OAuth metadata comes from Atlassian's own discovery endpoints.
